text: 🚨🎙️| Fermín López: “I don’t think I’ll overtake Raphinha because he’s an incredible player and will keep scoring goals. I’ll just focus on contributing with the team’s support.” #fcblive
Gavi and Flick after the win ❤

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “We know our quality. Even though we lost to Real Madrid and PSG, I don’t think we played badly. I have full confidence in my team and believe in our system. Just look at how we performed in the second half.” #fcblive 🔵🔴
Yikes...

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “We lacked intensity at the start, allowing Atlético to dominate the duels and individual battles. But we responded well, and the equaliser before half-time was crucial. In the second half, we took control of the game and deserved the victory.” #fcblive 🔵🔴

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “We have the quality to win these games, and I have great faith in this team. Winning here is never easy, so these three points are fantastic. However, there’s still a long way to go, and we work every day with the aim of winning titles.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Gavi: “Atlético Madrid are a very difficult opponent with the quality to hurt us. We know how challenging these games are, and facing them is always like a battle. The atmosphere here is incredibly intense, arguably one of the best in Europe, which puts you under immense pressure. That’s why securing the win today was so important for us.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “We discussed the possibility of Frenkie de Jong playing at right-back before the previous match, and he was willing to help wherever the team needed him. The plan was for him to spend around 50 minutes at right-back before moving into midfield when Marc Bernal became tired. That’s exactly how things worked out, and I believe we made the right decision.” #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “On a scale of 1 to 10, how important is it for us to be top of the table? I’d say 10.” #fcblive
